blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Thin, elongated structures are particularly sensitive to connectivity errors, as even a few local segmentation mistakes can disrupt otherwise continuous paths. Existing skeleton-based objectives typically supervise fixed centerline locations and do not account for alternative local routes that may restore connectivity. We propose TRACE, a topology-aware, prediction-adaptive objective that uses a target skeleton to define required local connections. For each connection, TRACE identifies the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction and jointly supervises its bottleneck with the corresponding skeleton point. The supervision thus adapts to the evolving prediction rather than remaining fixed to the centerline. We further introduce a topology-aware skeleton carrier that preserves both foreground and class-specific topology, enabling reliable definition of these connections. Extensive experiments across six 2D and 3D benchmarks show that TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining strong segmentation accuracy with low training overhead. Code will be released upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 细长的结构对连通性错误特别敏感,因为即使是少数局部分解错误也会打乱否则会连续的路径. 现有基于骨架的目标通常监督固定中线位置,不考虑可能恢复连通性的其他当地路线。 我们提出TRACE,一个具有地貌意识,预测适应性的目标,它使用目标骨架来定义所需的局部连接. 对于每次连接,TRACE都会根据当前预测确定最简单的有效再连接,并用相应的骨干点共同监督其瓶颈. 因此,监督能够适应不断变化的预测,而不是固定在中线上。 我们进一步引入了一种具有地貌意识的骨架载体,既保留了前地地地貌,又保留了阶级特有地貌,从而能够对这些连接进行可靠的定义. 对6个二维和三维基准的广泛实验表明,TRACE改进了连通性和地貌,同时保持了很强的分化精度并降低了培训间接费用. 守则一经接受就会公布。

blocks.en: Segmentation of thin, elongated structures is particularly vulnerable to connectivity errors, as even a few misclassified pixels or voxels can break an otherwise continuous structure. This issue arises in retinal vessels [ 21 ] , cerebral vessels [ 27 , 26 ] , hepatic vessels [ 2 ] , pavement cracks [ 15 ] , and road networks [ 7 ] , where continuity is essential to structural integrity. Such local errors can fragment a single structure into multiple components while producing only minor changes in conventional region-overlap metrics [ 20 ] . Reliable thin-structure segmentation therefore requires preserving connectivity in addition to accurate region and boundary prediction.
blocks.zh: 细长结构的分化特别容易发生连接错误,因为即使是少数被错误分类的像素或狐狸也能打破原本是连续的结构. 这一问题出现在视网膜船只[21]、脑容器[27、26]、肝脏船只[2]、人行道裂缝[15]和公路网[7]中,在这些方面,连续性对结构完整性至关重要。 这种局部误差可能将单个结构分割成多个组件,而只产生常规区域重叠度量表的微小变化[20]. 因此,除了准确的区域和边界预测之外,可靠的薄结构分割还需要保持连通性。

blocks.en: Prior work preserves connectivity through centerline or skeleton supervision, global topological constraints, and local relational objectives. Centerline- and skeleton-based losses [ 20 , 1 , 19 ] provide direct structural supervision and may additionally incorporate boundary or width information. Target-only methods [ 13 ] avoid skeletonizing the prediction, reducing training-time computation and memory overhead. Their supervision, however, remains confined to fixed support derived from the ground truth. More broadly, skeleton-based support depends on the chosen skeletonization procedure [ 17 ] , and even topology-preserving support may not identify the prediction error responsible for a connectivity break. Global objectives based on persistent homology or component graphs [ 11 , 22 , 3 , 16 ] constrain connected components, loops, and cavities, yet provide limited guidance for repairing a specific local break. Neighbor-, affinity-, and path-based objectives [ 24 , 25 , 10 , 28 ] provide localized supervision through individual neighbors, selected point pairs, or graph paths. These formulations organize connectivity around individual relations or pairwise paths, leaving unresolved how to jointly reconnect all same-class branches affected by a local break under the current prediction.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过中心线或骨架监督、全球地形制约以及地方关系目标来维护连通性。 中心线和骨架损失[20,1,19]提供直接的结构监督,并可能额外包含边界或宽度信息. 唯目标方法[13]避免将预测骨架化,减少培训时间计算和内存间接费用. 然而,他们的监督仍然局限于从实地真相中获得的固定支持。 更广泛地说,基于骨架的支持依赖于所选择的骨架化程序[17],即使地形学-保存支持也可能无法识别导致连接中断的预测错误. 基于持久性同位素或组件图[11,22,3,16]的全球目标制约了连接的组件,循环,和腔,但为修复特定的局部断裂提供了有限的指导. 邻居、亲和和基于路径的目标[24、25、10、28]通过个别邻居、选定的点对或图表路径提供局部监督。 这些配体围绕个别关系或对偶路径组织连通,留下了未解决的问题,即如何根据当前预测,将受局部中断影响的所有同级分支联合连通.

blocks.en: We propose TRACE, a topology-aware objective that extends skeleton supervision from a fixed target to guidance for adaptive reconnection. TRACE uses a topology-preserving skeleton to identify neighboring same-class branches that should remain connected. Based on the current prediction, it identifies the easiest valid local reconnection and jointly supervises the skeleton point with the bottleneck limiting this reconnection. To support this formulation, we further introduce a Topology-Aware Skeleton Carrier (TASC), which preserves both foreground and class-specific topology while defining local connectivity requirements. We identify the reconnection bottleneck through an exact local search using centered logit-margin scores derived directly from standard semantic logits. The proposed objective avoids costly prediction-side skeletonization and requires no architectural modifications, enabling efficient plug-and-play integration into existing segmentation pipelines.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TRACE,一个具有地貌意识的目标,将骨架监督从固定目标延伸至适应性再连接的指导. TRACE使用保存地形的骨架来识别邻近的同级分支,这些分支应该保持连接. 基于目前的预测,它确定了最简单的有效的局部重联,并联合监督骨架点与瓶颈限制这种重联. 为了支持这一表述,我们进一步引入了一种地形学-Aware Skeleton carrier(TASC),它既保留了前景学,又保留了特定阶层的地形学,同时确定了本地的连通性要求. 我们通过精确的局部搜索来识别重联瓶颈, 使用直接从标准语义日志中得出的中心对数-边距分数。 拟议的目标避免了昂贵的预测侧骨架化,不需要进行建筑改造,从而能够有效地将插头和游戏融入现有的分区管道。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce TRACE, a prediction-adaptive connectivity objective that uses a skeleton to define required connections and supervises the easiest reconnection bottleneck. • We present TASC, a class-labeled skeleton that preserves both foreground and class-specific topology while identifying same-class branches that should remain connected. • Across six 2D and 3D thin-structure benchmarks, TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining strong region-overlap and boundary accuracy. • We further demonstrate that TRACE is computationally efficient, generalizes across segmentation backbones, and complements existing topology-aware methods.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Centerline and skeleton supervision. Centerline- and skeleton-based objectives promote connectivity by supervising thin structural representations derived from the prediction, target, or both. clDice [ 20 ] measures reciprocal overlap between the prediction and target using differentiable soft skeletons. Menten et al. [ 17 ] developed topology-preserving differentiable skeletonization for gradient-based losses. clCE [ 1 ] applies cross-entropy at centerline locations to improve topology while preserving region accuracy. cbDice [ 19 ] incorporates boundary and radius cues to preserve geometry across varying widths. Skeleton Recall Loss (SkelRecall) [ 13 ] uses a dilated, class-labeled target skeleton and avoids prediction-side skeletonization. These methods, however, tie structural supervision to centerline or skeleton support and do not explicitly identify the prediction error that blocks a valid reconnection. TRACE addresses this gap with a topology-preserving carrier that defines the local same-class branches to be connected and extends pointwise supervision to the bottleneck of their easiest valid reconnection.
blocks.zh: 中线和骨架监督。 基于中心线和骨架的目标通过监督从预测、目标或两者中得出的细小的结构表述,促进连通性。 显示 Dice [20] 使用不同的软骨架测量预测和目标之间的对等重叠. 孟腾等. [17] 开发了基于梯度损失的地形-保留可变骨架化. CLCE [1] 在中线位置应用跨直线,以改善地形,同时保持区域准确性. 页:1 Dice [19] 包含边界和半径提示,以保留不同宽度的几何特征. Skeleton Recall Loss (Skel Recall) [13] 使用一个膨胀的,带有类标签的目标骨架,避免了预测侧骨架化. 然而,这些方法将结构监督与中心线或骨架支持捆绑在一起,没有明确识别阻碍有效重联的预测错误. TRACE通过一个保存地形的载体来解决这一缺口,该载体定义了要连接的本地同级分支,并将指向监管延伸到最容易有效连接的瓶颈。

blocks.en: Global topology supervision. Global topology objectives constrain connected components, loops, and cavities across the segmentation. TopoLoss [ 11 ] uses persistent homology to identify predictions associated with topological errors. Betti Matching [ 22 ] matches topological features between the prediction and target while accounting for their spatial correspondence. Subsequent extensions support multiclass segmentation [ 3 ] . Topograph [ 16 ] represents prediction–target component relations as a graph to provide efficient binary and multiclass constraints. Whereas these methods constrain global or component-level topology, TRACE targets a required local reconnection and directly supervises its prediction-dependent bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 全球地形学监督. 全球地形学目标制约着连接的组件、环路和横断面的洞穴。 TopoLoss [11] 使用持久的同义词来识别与地形错误相关的预测. 贝蒂匹配 [22] 匹配预测与目标之间的地形特征,同时计算它们的空间对应. 随后的扩展支持多类分割[3]. Topograph [16] 代表预测 - 目标成分关系,作为提供高效二进制和多类约束的图表. 虽然这些方法制约了全球或组成部分一级的地形,但TRACE针对的是必要的局部重联,并直接监督其依赖预测的瓶颈。

blocks.en: Pairwise and path supervision. Pairwise- and path-based objectives supervise connectivity through neighboring elements, point pairs, or graph paths. MALIS [ 24 ] assigns pairwise connectivity errors to the weakest edge along a maximin path in an affinity graph. CAPE [ 10 ] penalizes shortest-path costs between selected target-graph nodes on a predicted distance map. SCNP [ 25 ] adjusts semantic logits according to the weakest same-class neighbor. WPRF [ 28 ] optimizes widest-path reachability between sampled point pairs on a target-derived support graph using a separate affinity prediction. In contrast, TRACE defines each local reconnection on a class-labeled carrier that preserves the topology of both the foreground union and each semantic class. Removing a carrier point exposes all neighboring same-class branches, which we jointly reconnect via an exact search over at most 9 candidate points in 2D or 27 in 3D, using a centered logit margin computed directly from standard multiclass semantic logits.
blocks.zh: 对等和路径监督。 对等目标与路径目标通过相邻元素,点对或图路径监督连接. MALIS [24] 在亲和图中将双向连接错误分配到最弱的边缘上。 CAPE [10] 惩罚预测距离图上选定目标图节点之间最短路径成本. SCNP [25]根据最弱的同级邻居调整语义逻辑. WPRF [28]利用单独的亲和性预测,在目标衍生支持图上优化了抽样点对之间最宽的可达性。 与此相对照,TRACE定义了每个本地重联在一个类标记的载体上,既保留了前缘结合的地形,又保留了每个语义类的地形. 删除一个载体点会暴露所有相邻的同级分支,我们通过精确搜索在2D的最多9个候选点或3D的27个候选点,通过直接从标准多级语义日志中计算出一个中心对数比值,将这些分支重新连接起来。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: TRACE turns target-skeleton supervision from fixed-point enforcement into prediction-adaptive local reconnection by identifying and supervising the bottleneck of the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction. We first formulate local reconnection as a connectivity bottleneck problem that requires a connected set of target-class points to reach all neighboring branches ( Sec. 3.1 ). We then construct TASC, a thin class-labeled carrier that encodes these connectivity requirements while preserving both foreground and class-specific topology ( Sec. 3.2 ). Next, we define a centered logit-margin score that ranks candidate points by their rival-to-target margin relative to the carrier average ( Sec. 3.3 ). Finally, we combine the pointwise and connectivity penalties into a structural objective ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: TRACE通过识别和监督当前预测中最容易有效重联的瓶颈,将目标-斯凯莱顿监督从固定点执行转变为预测-适应局部重联. 我们首先将本地重联制定为连接瓶颈问题,需要一组连接的目标等级点才能到达所有邻近分支(第3.1条)。 然后,我们建造了TASC, 一种带有细薄类标签的载体,它编码了这些连接要求,同时保留了前景和特定类的地形(第3.2条)。 接下来,我们确定一个中心对数-边距分数,按候选人的对手对目标比值相对于承运人平均数的比值(第3.3节)排序。 最后,我们将断点罚和连通罚合并为一个结构目标(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate TRACE on six thin-structure segmentation benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D data, including binary and multiclass tasks. DRIVE [ 21 ] is used for retinal vessel segmentation and contains 40 RGB fundus images, split into 20/10/10 for training/validation/testing. DeepCrack [ 15 ] contains 537 RGB images for surface-crack segmentation (270/30/237), while DeepGlobe Roads [ 7 ] contains 6,226 RGB satellite images for road segmentation (4,980/622/624). For DSCA [ 27 ] , we convert 224 cerebral digital subtraction angiography sequences, annotated for the main arterial trunk and bifurcated vessels, into 2D minimum-intensity projections and use a 144/36/44 split. MSD Hepatic Vessel [ 2 ] contains 303 portal-venous-phase 3D CT scans with hepatic vessel and tumor annotations; we treat tumor voxels as background for binary vessel segmentation and use a 243/30/30 split. TopCoW [ 26 ] contains 125 3D CT angiography scans with multiclass annotations for 13 Circle of Willis vessel segments, split into 100/12/13 cases.

blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate segmentation quality using complementary metrics for connectivity, topology, boundary accuracy, and region overlap. We first report clDice [ 20 ] to measure centerline consistency and connectivity preservation. We also report the absolute Betti number error, β = | Δ ​ β 0 | + | Δ ​ β 1 | \beta=|\Delta\beta_{0}|+|\Delta\beta_{1}| [ 22 ] , to quantify topological errors associated with structural connectivity. The 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) [ 23 ] assesses boundary accuracy by measuring spatial disagreement while limiting outlier sensitivity. Finally, Dice [ 9 ] measures region overlap and assesses whether improved structural consistency is achieved without sacrificing overall segmentation accuracy. We compute each metric independently for each foreground class in every test sample. For multiclass datasets, we average the class-wise values to obtain one score per metric per sample, then average these per-sample scores over the entire test set.

blocks.en:
Baselines. Our primary focus is connectivity preservation; therefore, we conduct extensive comparisons with representative skeleton-based losses, including clDice [ 20 ] , clDice with topology-preserving skeletonization (Topo-clDice) [ 17 ] , clCE [ 1 ] , cbDice [ 19 ] , and SkelRecall [ 13 ] .
We also include the recent multiclass extension of Betti Matching [ 3 ] as a consistent global-topology reference across binary and multiclass benchmarks, using the projection-based protocol of [ 14 ] for 3D volumes.
To isolate the effects of the training objective, the main benchmark evaluates representative methods using standard semantic outputs while keeping the prediction head and inference pipeline fixed. We exclude methods that require alternative output formulations, auxiliary or correction modules, or post-processing from this controlled comparison.

我们还将最近Betti Matching [3] 的多类扩展作为跨越二进制和多类基准的一致全球地形学参考,对3D卷采用[14]的预测协议。

blocks.en: 4.3 Topology Preservation and Training Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.3 保存地形和培训效率

blocks.en: Topology preservation. We assess whether each method’s target-side skeleton representation preserves topology across deep-supervision scales. We use clDice [ 20 ] as a representative differentiable soft-skeletonization method, Topo-clDice [ 17 ] as its topology-preserving counterpart, and SkelRecall [ 13 ] as a target skeleton-based method. At each active scale, we construct the skeleton from the corresponding training target using each method and record a topology violation if the Betti numbers change for the foreground union or any present semantic class. We report the percentage of target–scale pairs exhibiting at least one violation.
blocks.zh: 地形学保护. 我们评估每种方法的目标侧骨架表现是否保留了深层视觉尺度的地形。 我们使用 ClDice [20] 作为一种具有代表性的可分辨的软-斯凯利化方法, Topo-clDice [17] 作为它的地形保留对应方法, SkelRecall [13] 作为基于骨架的目标方法. 在每一个活动尺度上,我们用每一种方法从相应的训练目标中构造骨架,并记录如果贝蒂数字为前缘联盟或任何现时语义课而改变的话,就会出现地形违规. 我们报告至少出现一次违规的目标对比例。

blocks.en: Training efficiency. We evaluate the training overhead of TRACE against the same representative methods under an identical nnU-Net setup, with Dice + CE as the reference. We report training time per epoch and peak process GPU memory on an NVIDIA H200 (140 GB); runs exceeding the available GPU memory are reported as out of memory (OOM). Topology preservation can still be evaluated in OOM cases, whereas training efficiency cannot be assessed without a completed epoch.
blocks.zh: 培训效率。 我们对照相同的nU-Net设置,以Dice + CE作为参考,对照相同的代表性方法,评估TRACE的训练管理费用。 我们在 NVIDIA H200 (140 GB) 上报告每个时代和高峰过程的训练时间 GPU 内存;运行超过可用的 GPU 内存被报告为内存外(OOM). 在OOM案件中,仍可评价地形保存情况,而培训效率在没有完成的划时代的情况下无法评估。

blocks.en: 4.4 Backbone Transfer and Method Compatibility
blocks.zh: 4.4 背骨传输和方法兼容性

blocks.en: We evaluate TRACE’s plug-and-play capability in two settings: transfer to a different segmentation backbone and integration with another topology-aware method.
blocks.zh: 我们评价TRACE在两种情况下的插座和游戏能力:转移到不同的分块主干线上和与另一种地貌意识方法相结合.

blocks.en: Transfer to CS 2 -Net [ 18 ] . We integrate TRACE with CS 2 -Net to assess its generalization performance across segmentation architectures. We compare TRACE against the standard training objective and representative structural losses on DeepCrack and DRIVE.
blocks.zh: 转入CS 2-Net [18]. 我们把TRACE与CS 2-Net整合在一起,以评估其跨分区结构的概括性表现. 我们比较TRACE与DeepCrack和DRIVE的标准训练目标和代表性结构损失.

blocks.en: Integration with SCNP [ 25 ] . We further investigate whether TRACE provides complementary connectivity supervision when combined with an existing topology-aware approach. Specifically, we compare Dice + CE applied to the SCNP-transformed logits with the same objective augmented by TRACE. We conduct experiments on DRIVE and DSCA using nnU-Net.
blocks.zh: 与SCNP整合 [25]. 我们进一步调查TRACE是否在结合现有地貌认识方法的同时提供互补的连通性监督. 具体地说,我们将Dice + CE应用于SCNP转换成的日志与TRACE增强的同一目标进行比较. 我们使用nU-Net进行DRIVE和DSCA的实验.

blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

We evaluate all configurations on DRIVE.

blocks.en: 5 Result and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Main comparison. TRACE consistently outperforms competing methods across all six benchmark datasets. As shown in Tabs. 1 and 2 , it achieves the best or near-best results in both 2D and 3D settings, covering binary and multiclass segmentation tasks. The qualitative results in Fig. 3 further support these findings: compared with competing methods, TRACE produces more continuous local structures with fewer visible discontinuities while preserving the overall geometry and semantic extent of the predictions. This agreement between quantitative and qualitative results indicates that prediction-adaptive bottleneck supervision effectively improves structural connectivity. In particular, the proposed approach places structural supervision at prediction-dependent reconnection bottlenecks rather than repeatedly enforcing it at fixed skeleton locations.
blocks.zh: 主比较. TRACE在所有6个基准数据集中一贯超越相互竞争的方法。 如 Tabs. 1 和 2 所示,它在 2D 和 3D 设置中都取得了最佳或接近最佳的结果,涵盖了二进制和多级分割任务. 图3的质量结果进一步支持了这些结论:与相互竞争的方法相比,TRACE产生更连续的局部结构,可见的不连续较少,同时保留了预测的整体几何和语义范围. 这种定量和定性结果之间的一致表明,预测-适应性的瓶颈监督有效地改善了结构连接。 特别是,拟议办法将结构监督置于依赖预测的重新连接瓶颈,而不是在固定骨架地点反复实施。

blocks.en: Topology preservation and training efficiency. TRACE preserves target topology across output scales while maintaining practical training efficiency. As shown in Fig. 4 , TASC exhibits no observed topology violations on any benchmark, whereas the compared skeleton constructions can alter the original target topology. Topo-clDice preserves the topology of individual classes; however, independently skeletonizing each class can alter the topology of the foreground union. The efficiency results further show that TRACE requires substantially less training time and GPU memory than differentiable soft-skeletonization alternatives, while remaining close to lightweight target-only supervision. This efficiency stems from constructing TASC solely from the target and restricting reconnection search to a small local neighborhood, making TRACE practical for routine use.
blocks.zh: 地形保存和培训效率。 TRACE在保持实际培训效率的同时,保留了整个产出规模的目标地形。 如图4所示,TASC在任何基准上都没有观察到的地形违规现象,而比较的骨架构造可以改变原目标地形。 托宝Cl 虱子保留了个别阶级的地形;然而,独立骨架化每个阶级可以改变前缘结合的地形. 效率结果进一步表明,TRACE需要的培训时间和GPU内存大大少于不同的软斯凯通化替代品,同时保持接近轻量级目标监督. 这种效率来源于仅从目标建造TASC,并且限制重新连接搜索到一个小的局部街区,使得TRACE成为日常使用的实用.

blocks.en: Backbone transfer and method compatibility. TRACE is a plug-and-play objective that transfers across segmentation backbones and complements existing topology-aware supervision. The CS 2 -Net results in Tab. 3 show improved connectivity and topology over the standard objective and compared structural losses. In Tab. 4 , adding TRACE to SCNP improves all reported metrics, demonstrating complementary benefits beyond SCNP’s weakest-neighbor supervision. Because TRACE operates directly on standard semantic logits and target labels, it integrates into existing training pipelines without modifying the prediction head or inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 后骨传输和方法兼容性. TRACE是一个插座和游戏目标,可以跨分区骨干转移,并补充现有的地形意识监督. CS 2-Net结果在 Tab. 3显示在标准目标及比较结构损失方面,连接和地形有所改善。 在表4中,在SCNP中增加TRACE可以改进所有已报告的衡量标准,表明除了SCNP最薄弱的邻里监督之外,还有补充性的好处。 由于TRACE直接在标准语义日志和目标标签上运行,因此在不修改预测头或推论程序的情况下融入了现有的训练管道.

blocks.en: Ablation. The ablation study shows that the main components of TRACE provide complementary improvements. As shown in Tab. 5 , replacing the conventional target skeleton with TASC improves structural consistency, while the centered logit-margin score further improves topology and boundary accuracy. Prediction-adaptive reconnection provides additional gains, and the bounded penalty integration in the full TRACE yields the best performance. These results suggest that topology-aware supervision, class-aware scoring, and adaptive reconnection each improve structural accuracy.
blocks.zh: 纵横. 消化研究显示,TRACE的主要组成部分提供了互补的改进. 如Tab. 5所示,将常规目标骨架替换为TASC提高了结构一致性,而中心对数-边距得分则进一步提高了地形学和边界精度. 预测性适应性再连接可带来额外收益,在完全TRACE中设定的处罚整合产生最佳表现. 这些结果表明,地形意识监督、阶级意识评分和适应性再连接都提高了结构准确性。

blocks.en: Limitation and future work. TRACE shows consistent performance across diverse thin-structure segmentation tasks. Nevertheless, its structural supervision depends on the topology encoded in the ground-truth annotations. Small annotation errors may introduce isolated fragments, spurious branches, or local loops, which TASC preserves because removing them would alter the annotated topology, as illustrated in Fig. 5 . A promising direction is to combine TASC with uncertainty-aware filtering or consistency-based refinement to suppress unreliable topological annotations.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 TRACE在各种薄结构分割任务中表现出一致的性能. 然而,其结构监督取决于地真相说明中编码的地形。 如图5所示,小的注释错误可能引入孤立的片段、假树枝或局部环路,TASC保留了这些内容,因为删除这些内容会改变注解的地形。 一个有希望的方向是将TASC与不确定性意识过滤或基于一致性的改进结合起来,以压制不可靠的地形说明。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Annotation-induced artifacts in TASC. Small isolated regions and local irregularities in the ground-truth masks (arrows) are retained as isolated points or short loops because TASC preserves the annotated topology.
blocks.zh: 图5: TASC中由注释引起的文物. 由于TASC保留了注解的地形,所以小的孤立地区和当地在地面真伪面具(窄)中的违规行为被保留为孤立点或短环.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose TRACE, an efficient topology-aware objective that reframes skeleton supervision as prediction-adaptive local reconnection. TASC provides a class-labeled topological carrier that preserves foreground and class-specific topology while identifying same-class branches that should remain connected. Based on this representation, TRACE identifies the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction and supervises its critical bottleneck. Across six 2D and 3D benchmarks covering binary and multiclass segmentation, TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining region-overlap and boundary accuracy. It also preserves target topology across deep-supervision scales, introduces only modest training overhead, and requires no architectural or inference-time modifications. Its transferability across backbones and compatibility with existing topology-aware methods further demonstrate that TRACE is a practical plug-and-play approach for thin-structure segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TRACE,一个高效的地貌意识目标,将骨架监督重新设定为预测适应局部重联. TASC提供一种带有类标签的地形载体,它保留了前地和阶级特有的地形,同时确定了应该保持连接的同级分支. 基于这种表述,TRACE在目前的预测中确定了最简单的有效重联,并监督其关键瓶颈. TRACE在涵盖二进制和多级分割的6个2D和3D基准中,改进了连通性和地形,同时保持了区域重叠和边界准确性。 它还在深层超视距尺度上保留了目标地形,只引入了适度的培训间接费用,不需要建筑或推论时间的修改. 其跨骨干线的可转移性和与现有地形意识方法的兼容性进一步表明TRACE是薄结构分割的一种实用的插值和玩法.
